::: {.gcpp-hero__lede}
**2026–2027 Cohort.** The Network for Advanced Study Fellowship, offered by the Takshashila Institution, is designed for those who want to develop serious, sustained work in their field. Fellows work on a research topic of their choice, with structured mentorship from Takshashila scholars and a network of domestic and international subject-matter specialists.
:::
:::

::: {.gcpp-hero__aside}
::: {.eyebrow}
Overview
:::
| | |
|---|---|
| **DURATION**        | September 2026 – July 2027 |
| **FORMAT**          | Hybrid · mostly online, with two in-person workshops |
| **TIME COMMITMENT** | About 8 hours / week |
| **FELLOWS**         | Up to 6 per track |
| **PROGRAMME FEE**   | INR 45,000 |
| **CASH AWARD**      | INR 1,00,000 per track (top performer) |
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}

<!-- ============ WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section dark">
  <div class="gcpp-container">
    <span class="eyebrow">What's in this for you</span>
    <h2 class="gcpp-h2">Mentorship, network, and range</h2>
    <div class="gcpp-questions">
      <div class="q-card">
        <span class="q-num">01 — DEDICATED MENTORSHIP</span>
        Each fellow is paired with a Takshashila researcher for the year and encouraged to translate their work into multiple formats — the primary research paper alongside policy briefs, op-eds, explainers, podcasts, or data visualisations. The result is a body of work that demonstrates range, not just depth.
      </div>
      <div class="q-card">
        <span class="q-num">02 — EXPERT NETWORK</span>
        A curated group of domestic and international experts delivers masterclass sessions and engages with the cohort throughout the programme year on relevant topics.
      </div>
      <div class="q-card">
        <span class="q-num">03 — IN-PERSON WORKSHOPS</span>
        Two in-person workshops in Bengaluru over the year, including guest seminars and peer-review sessions.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ DELIVERABLES ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section">
  <div class="gcpp-container">
    <span class="eyebrow">Deliverables</span>
    <h2 class="gcpp-h2">What fellows produce</h2>
    <p class="nasx-prose" style="margin-bottom:24px;">The fellowship runs from September 2026 to July 2027. Fellows commit about 8 hours per week on average — for research, attending meetings and seminars, and producing deliverables.</p>
    <div class="apply-list no-codes">
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>One substantive output</h3>
          <p>At least one substantive output during the programme year. Accepted outputs include journal papers, monographs, book chapters, and policy papers.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Regular public output</h3>
          <p>A public output every few weeks in the chosen domain — publishing op-eds, blogs, appearing on podcasts, and the like.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Innovative supplementary work</h3>
          <p>Fellows are encouraged to work on other innovative outputs to supplement their substantive output — quantitative models, simulations, and trackers or dashboards.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ PROGRAMME FEE ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section">

          <span class="fee-amt">₹45,000</span>
        </div>

      <div>
        <p class="nasx-prose">For the upcoming cohort, we have redesigned the fellowship to nurture a smaller group of researchers committed to producing rigorous, high-quality scholarship over the course of a year. The fee asserts the programme's emphasis on long-term commitment, regular engagement, and the successful completion of an original research project.</p>
        <p class="nasx-prose">Fellows sign a formal commitment document on joining. All public outputs produced during the fellowship are subject to organisational review before publication.</p>
        <p class="nasx-prose">This is primarily an online fellowship with no requirement for frequent travel. The two in-person workshops will require fellows to travel to either Delhi or Bengaluru; fellows are expected to self-fund their travel and accommodation.</p>
```
